vole.proof_class_note: designated-verifier interactive ZK (IT-MAC / VOLE): the verifier holds a secret key Delta; the transcript convinces nobody else. assumptions: Every figure is an estimate from explore.tensor's limb price list and security.accounting's row/pad/coin counts; nothing is measured.

The 'none' level keeps the same committed witness (inputs, hints, query wires, multiplicities, helpers) and removes only what exists for privacy: pads, randomizers (payload k instead of l), blinding rows, HM96 leaves, coin commitments.
HM96 leaves and coin commitments are hashed at the Merkle hash rate; the universal-hash evaluations are not priced (bit operations).
Prover randomness is PRG output at 100 GB/s (AES-CTR on SIMT, unmeasured); an HM96 x_j is 121 B; a salt 32 B.
Communication is the accountant's transcript estimate at 8 B per trace element (Goldilocks bytes even for 31-bit fields).

B-AIR: one row per unit, 2^19 rows at B=4096, rate 1/4 FRI in the proven unique-decoding regime with rows_log2 + 2 field-term applications; the quotient is 2^ceil(log2(deg-1)) chunks of F_c; leaves are LDE rows.  Relative deltas only.
